backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining core data types (Lead, Service, Project, Payment, UserProfile with AppRole enum) and state management using Map structures, integrating authorization, blob storage, Stripe payments, and HTTP outcalls.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including CSV/Excel lead import, lead dashboard with search/filter, Stripe payment integration, and web forms for lead capture with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend React components and hooks covering authentication, role-based access control, lead/service/payment management, dashboard analytics, and UI components with demo mode support.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes defining colors for UI elements (background, foreground, primary, secondary, sidebar, charts) using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Quick Bee AI Growth Engine application with favicon reference and root div mounting point for React.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application setup with TanStack Router defining routes for dashboard, leads, services, payments, and settings with role-based access control using RequireRole wrapper and AppShell layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminOnlyS: Empty file placeholder for admin-only UI section component.
frontend/src/components/admin/ClientServ: Empty file placeholder for admin panel to manage client service requests.
frontend/src/components/analytics/Revenu: Line chart component displaying revenue trends over time using Recharts, fetching payment data and computing trends with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/analytics/Servic: Displays a pie chart of service categories with revenue data, using Recharts and fetching analytics via useGetAgencyAnalytics hook. Shows loading, error, and empty states with color-coded category segments.
frontend/src/components/analytics/TopPer: Renders a horizontal bar chart showing top-performing services by revenue using Recharts. Fetches data via useGetAgencyAnalytics and displays loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Guards routes by checking Internet Identity authentication or demo session status, redirecting to login if unauthorized. Shows loading spinner during initialization.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to complete profile setup with name, email, mobile, agency, and role fields. Prefills email/mobile from stored sign-in identifier and calls registerUser mutation on submit.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireRole: Role-based access control component that checks user's role against allowed roles, restricting demo users to specific paths. Shows access denied card with required roles if unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/common/BlockedSt: Reusable card component displaying a blocked/warning state with icon, title, message, and optional action button. Uses AlertCircle icon and yellow color scheme.
frontend/src/components/common/ChartBloc: Wrapper card component for charts with title header and optional action slot. Provides consistent styling for analytics chart displays.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Displays error state with AlertTriangle icon, customizable title/message, and optional retry button. Centered card layout with red color scheme.
Card component displaying lead summary with status badge, niche icon, location, revenue potential, and owner. Includes button to open detailed lead dialog.
frontend/src/components/common/ProgressB: Progress bar component with optional label and percentage display, calculating percentage from value/max ratio. Shows formatted numbers below bar when percentage is hidden.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeImage: Image component with error handling that displays initials fallback on load failure. Shows loading skeleton while image loads.
frontend/src/components/common/ServiceNi: Renders 3D icons for services or niches using SafeImage with fallback to default icon. Accepts service object or niche string and generates initials for error states.
frontend/src/components/common/StatsCard: A reusable card component that displays a statistic with title, value, optional icon, subtitle, and trend indicator (positive/negative percentage change).
frontend/src/components/deals/DealCard.t: Displays a deal summary card with deal ID, status badge (color-coded), value in INR format, and associated lead ID. Supports optional status change callback.
frontend/src/components/deals/DealDialog: A dialog form for creating new deals with fields for value (INR), status selection (Open/Proposal Sent/Won/Lost), and associated lead ID. Uses mutation hook for deal creation.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportDat: Provides export functionality for all Quick Bee data in multiple formats (CSV, Excel, PDF-ready HTML, RTF/DOCX). Shows total record count and handles file generation and download with toast notifications.
Main application layout shell with responsive sidebar navigation, mobile menu toggle, Quick Bee logo, demo mode badge, and follow-up badge. Handles mobile overlay and content area with max-width container.
frontend/src/components/leads/AddLeadDia: Dialog form for adding new leads with required fields (name, contact, city, niche) and optional fields (status, revenue potential, owner). Uses current user profile for agency and owner defaults.
frontend/src/components/leads/ImportLead: Dialog for bulk importing leads from CSV or Excel files. Parses file content, validates required columns (name, contact, city, niche), displays import results with success/error counts, and shows detailed error messages.
frontend/src/components/leads/LeadDetail: A dialog component for viewing and editing lead details with tabs for details/edit views, form inputs for lead properties, and integration with useUpdateLeadStatus hook for persisting changes.
frontend/src/components/nav/FollowUpBadg: A notification badge component that displays follow-ups due today in a popover, though the actual follow-up date tracking is noted as a placeholder not yet implemented.
frontend/src/components/nav/SidebarNav.t: The main sidebar navigation component that displays filtered nav items based on user role/permissions, shows demo mode badge, handles authentication/session clearing, and highlights the active route.
frontend/src/components/outreach/StartOu: A dialog form for recording outreach activities with a lead, capturing platform, message, and automatically setting a 7-day follow-up date using the useAddOutreach hook.
frontend/src/components/payments/Checkou: A checkout dialog that handles payment method selection (UPI/Razorpay/Stripe), creates payment orders or Stripe checkout sessions, and displays payment instructions with auto-scrolling behavior.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Displays a list of user payments with service names, status badges, payment methods, and allows admins to update payment status through a dropdown selector.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Admin-only dialog component for configuring Stripe payment integration with secret key and allowed countries. Validates country codes and displays success/error toasts on submission.
frontend/src/components/planner/PlannerP: Displays a 30-day planner plan with summary cards showing overall progress, current streak, and days remaining. Lists daily tasks with completion status and highlights today's tasks.
frontend/src/components/projects/Project: Dialog for viewing and editing project details including notes, completion progress, milestones, and file attachments. Supports file upload and removal with update functionality.
Dialog for creating or editing projects with service and client selection, notes, and status. Validates user profile and required fields before submitting to backend.
frontend/src/components/services/Service: Modal displaying comprehensive service details including price, delivery time, deliverables, requirements, and supported providers. Features 3D icons and optional checkout action.

A dialog component for creating and editing services with a comprehensive form including fields for name, price, delivery time, descriptions, deliverables, requirements, and supported providers. Handles form submission, validation, and integrates with the useAddService hook to persist service data.
frontend/src/components/uploads/Attachme: Displays a list of ExternalBlob attachments with preview, download, and optional remove actions. Supports image preview in a modal dialog and distinguishes between image and document file types.

A file upload component that allows users to select multiple files, validates them, converts to ExternalBlob format with upload progress tracking, and passes uploaded blobs to a callback. Supports common file types including images, PDFs, and Office documents.
frontend/src/constants/uploadedImages.ts: Centralized mapping of static image asset URLs for branding, platform icons, service illustrations, and team/workspace images. Uses publicAssetUrl utility for base-path aware URL generation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance with authentication, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state. Automatically invalidates and refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAgencyAnalytics.ts: Fetches aggregated analytics data including leads, services, and projects from the backend. Returns empty arrays for unimplemented features (deals, outreach) and handles errors gracefully.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRole.ts: Provides hooks to query the current user's role and admin status from the backend. Gracefully handles unauthorized/guest user scenarios by returning null or false.
frontend/src/hooks/useClientServiceReque: Manages client service requests with hooks for creating requests and fetching them by agency or for all users. Automatically invalidates queries after mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks for fetching, saving, and registering user profiles with the backend. Handles authentication state and invalidates related queries after profile updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeals.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating deals (useGetUserDeals, useUpdateDealStatus, useCreateDeal, useUpdateDeal) with role-based access control for managers/admins and demo mode restrictions. Backend implementation is incomplete, returning empty arrays and logging warnings.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: Custom React hook that debounces a value by delaying updates until a specified delay (default 300ms) has passed without changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoSession.ts: Manages demo session state with local storage persistence and backend synchronization, providing startDemo and endDemo functions that interact with the actor's demo session methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useExportData.ts: Provides a React Query hook to fetch exportable data (leads, deals, outreach, services, projects) from the backend, with deals and outreach returning empty arrays as they're not implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options for identity provider and delegation.
frontend/src/hooks/useLeads.ts: Provides React Query hooks for lead management (fetch all, paginated fetch, add, update status, import) with role-based access control for managers/admins and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useOutreach.ts: Provides React Query hooks for outreach activity management (fetch, add, update status) with role-based access control, but backend implementation is incomplete and returns empty arrays with console warnings.
frontend/src/hooks/usePayments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for payment operations including creating payments, fetching user/all payments, getting individual payments, updating payment status, and retrieving payment settings.
frontend/src/hooks/usePaymentSettings.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and update payment settings with admin-only access control and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanner.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing a 30-day planner with daily lead and outreach targets, storing plan data in memory with mutations for creating plans and updating task progress.
frontend/src/hooks/useProjects.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching, creating, updating, and completing projects with role-based access control (manager/admin only) and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a React Query hook to fetch the current user's AppRole from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServices.ts: Exports hooks for fetching all services, adding services, updating service status, and seeding multiple services with admin-only access control and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionAppRole.ts: Custom hook that manages selected AppRole state synchronized with session storage, providing functions to set and clear the role.
frontend/src/hooks/useSettings.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update global settings with admin-only access control and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeCheckout.ts: Exports a mutation hook to create Stripe checkout sessions from shopping items, parsing the JSON response to extract the checkout URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeConfiguratio: Provides hooks to check if Stripe is configured and to set Stripe configuration via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space, plus utility classes for page headers, cards, focus states, and teal-green gradient effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root App component wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx: Displays agency analytics dashboard with key metrics (revenue, close rate, avg deal value, leads) and charts showing revenue by service and niche using Recharts components.
Page component for client onboarding (content truncated in provided snippet).
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying agency analytics including leads, outreach, deals, revenue metrics, charts (bar, pie, line), conversion funnel, and an export data section. Shows a welcome screen with an image when no leads exist.
frontend/src/pages/DealsPage.tsx: Displays deals organized in a kanban-style board with four columns (Open, Proposal Sent, Won, Lost). Includes a button to add new deals via a dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LeadsPage.tsx: Paginated leads list page with search, status filter, niche filter, and options to add leads manually or import from CSV/Excel. Clicking a lead opens a detail dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Authentication page offering Internet Identity login or demo mode login (username: 'demo', password: 'demo123') with role selection. Redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/OutreachPage.tsx: Multi-channel outreach tracking page with tabs for Email, WhatsApp, Call, and LinkedIn platforms. Displays outreach activities filtered by selected platform.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure/cancellation page displaying an error message, session ID, and options to retry payment, return to dashboard, or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment success confirmation page showing session ID with buttons to view payment history or browse services.
frontend/src/pages/PlannerPage.tsx: Displays a 30-day planner page for tracking 3000 outreach goals, showing either an onboarding view with feature cards or the active plan view with progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Manages client project tracking with a grid view of project cards showing status, completion progress, and file attachments, with dialogs for creating and viewing project details.
frontend/src/pages/ProposalSharePage.tsx: Placeholder page for future proposal sharing functionality that is not currently registered in the router.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Displays and manages all services with search, filtering, status toggling, and catalog seeding functionality, including checkout and detail dialogs for each service.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPricingPage.t: Public-facing pricing page displaying categorized service offerings (websites, WhatsApp automation, lead generation, personal branding) with features and checkout integration.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Tabbed settings page for managing user profile, payment settings (UPI, Razorpay, Stripe), and viewing payment history with role-based access controls.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Optional sign-in page that collects user identifier (email/phone) before redirecting to Internet Identity authentication for secure login.
frontend/src/pages/UnauthorizedPage.tsx: Displays an access denied page with a shield alert icon and a button to navigate back to the dashboard when users lack permissions.
frontend/src/types/docx.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the 'docx' library, including enums for alignment, borders, width types, and classes for creating Word documents with paragraphs, tables, and formatting.
frontend/src/types/jspdf-autotable.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the 'jspdf-autotable' plugin, defining interfaces for table generation options, cell definitions, column inputs, and styling.
frontend/src/types/jspdf.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the 'jspdf' library, including the jsPDF class constructor, text/font methods, page management, and output formats.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: Defines local TypeScript interfaces for Deal and OutreachActivity that are not exported from the backend.
frontend/src/types/xlsx.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the 'xlsx' library, including interfaces for workbooks, worksheets, and utility functions for reading/writing Excel files.
frontend/src/utils/adminAllowlist.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for admin allowlist functionality.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeReve: Computes daily revenue trends from payment data by filtering paid payments, grouping by date, and returning sorted time-series data.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeServ: Aggregates services by niche/category, computing count and total revenue for each category, sorted by revenue descending.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeTopP: Identifies and returns the top 10 services ranked by revenue from a list of services.
frontend/src/utils/assets/publicAssetUrl: Generates base-path aware URLs for static assets from the public directory, handling both development and production deployments with non-root base paths.
frontend/src/utils/export/download.ts: Utility function to trigger browser download of a Blob with a specified filename using a temporary object URL.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportCsv.ts: Generates CSV export files from ExportData by creating sections for leads, outreach, services, deals, and projects with proper CSV escaping.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportDocx.ts: Generates RTF format documents (openable in Word) from ExportData without external libraries, creating formatted sections for each data type.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportPdf.ts: Generates HTML documents styled for PDF printing from ExportData, creating formatted tables for leads, outreach, services, deals, and projects.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportSchema.t: Defines export field schemas and formatting functions for leads, outreach activities, services, deals, and projects, including currency and date formatting.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportXlsx.ts: Generates XLSX files from export data using SpreadsheetML XML format without external dependencies. Creates worksheets for leads, outreach, services, deals, and projects with styled headers and properly escaped cell data.
frontend/src/utils/export/filename.ts: Provides utility functions to generate timestamped filenames for exports (format: quickbee-{scope}-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM) and format human-readable timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/icons/serviceNiche3dI: Maps service types/subtypes and niche values to 3D icon asset URLs. Provides getServiceIcon() and getNicheIcon() functions with fallback to default icons when no specific mapping exists.
frontend/src/utils/leads/csv.ts: Parses CSV and Excel files to Lead objects with validation of required columns (name, contact, city, niche). Returns parsed leads and any validation errors encountered during processing.
frontend/src/utils/rbac.ts: Implements role-based access control (RBAC) defining route permissions for Admin, Manager, and Client roles. Includes demo mode restrictions and helper functions to check path access and role privileges.
Defines a comprehensive catalog of pre-configured services across Website & Funnel, AI & Automation, and Marketing & Growth categories with pricing, delivery times, and descriptions for seeding the service database.
frontend/src/utils/services/serviceDetai: Provides utility functions to parse newline-separated strings into arrays and vice versa for service detail fields like deliverables and requirements.
frontend/src/utils/sessionAuth.ts: Manages session authentication state in sessionStorage, storing and retrieving user role (Admin/Manager/Client/Demo) and demo session flags with validation and clearing functions.
frontend/src/utils/signInIdentifier.ts: Handles sign-in identifier storage and classification, distinguishing between email and phone formats, normalizing phone numbers, and providing matching logic for identifier comparison.
frontend/src/utils/uploads/fileValidatio: Validates uploaded files against allowed types (images, PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX) and enforces a 10MB size limit, returning validation results with specific error messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, gradient utilities, container queries, typography plugin, and animation support.
project_state.json: Project state file for Quick Bee Agency lead management system documenting four existing features: CSV/Excel upload, lead dashboard with search/filter, Stripe payment integration, and web forms for lead capture.
